headline: Apple renews Ted Lasso for a fifth season
summary: Apple TV renewed Ted Lasso for a fifth season after what the company called a record-breaking fourth-season debut. No details on the new season or its premiere date have been released yet.

claims.statement: Apple renewed Ted Lasso for a fifth season.
